release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $1,174M came in BELOW the company's own $1,190-1,210M guide (12% y/y, Europe ARPU -7%), and the Q4 guide of $1,425-1,475M (midpoint $1,450M, 8-12% growth) sits about 4-5% under the ~$1.51-1.52bn consensus the thesis said the stock trades on; with a history of -9% to -22% on soft guides this is a clear miss on the key line, sized above the 12.6% implied move.

key_line.detail: $1,425-1,475M, 8-12% y/y, modest FX headwind; midpoint ~$1.45bn vs ~$1.51-1.52bn consensus. Adj. EBITDA guide $538-588M.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue guide ~4% below street at the midpoint; Q3 itself missed the company's own range. No new buyback authorisation, no Q3 repurchases.

call.detail: Call held last night; its content was not reviewed in the time available. The after-hours print was -7.6% and the pre-market low -9.8% before recovering to -6.6%, which may reflect softer-than-feared call commentary (inference, not verified).

public_reaction.summary: Not reviewed in the time available.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 18.61 = -6.6% vs prev close 19.92, at the pre-market high (range 17.97-18.63), active tape (104 prints, 16 in last 30m, last 09:19, not stale). The release read is -15%; the pre-market holds less than half of that, and QQQ is -2.6% pre-market so the tape is not helping. Position is -9.0% from the 13:30 entry.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a Q4 guide above a ~$1.52bn consensus on an easy comp; the guide came in well below it and Q3 missed the company's own range.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market after a full night to read an amc print, so the open should hold the -6.6%. Gaps usually fade, but the pre-market already bounced off its low to its high, the guide miss is unambiguous and the Nasdaq is weak, so a fade toward the close is less likely than usual.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers gaan tegen de these in: de omzet viel onder Pinterests eigen prognose en de prognose voor het vierde kwartaal ligt zo'n 4% onder wat analisten verwachtten. De voorbeurs (-6,6%) prijst dat naar onze inschatting nog niet volledig in en de hele techmarkt staat lager, dus verkoop bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 verder oploopt richting -3% of beter, met nieuws over een nieuwe inkoop van aandelen, dan wordt wachten tot 10:00 verdedigbaar.
